newsitem.title: USA: EA Q3 sales lower from shifted deliveries.
newsitem.headline: EA Q3 sales lower from shifted deliveries.

text.p: EA Industries Inc said Tuesday that three major customers who postponed delivery schedules caused third quarter sales to be lower than expected.

The customers reduced orders by shifting delivery schedules from the third and fourth quarters to early 1997, the company said. EA Industries said orders from these three customers "will begin rebounding in early 1997."
Earlier today EA reported a third quarter loss of $0.31 per share on sales of $17.6 million, compared to a loss of $1.21 on sales of $18.6 million in the year-ago quarter.
